entries.title: Psalms 144:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Blessed be Jehovah my rock, who teacheth my hands to war, my fingers to fight;

entries.title: Psalms 144:2
segments: My mercy and my fortress, my high tower and my deliverer, my shield and he in whom I trust, who subdueth my people under me!

entries.title: Psalms 144:3
segments: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him, the son of man, that thou takest thought of him?

entries.title: Psalms 144:4
segments: Man is like to vanity; his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

entries.title: Psalms 144:5
segments: Jehovah, bow thy heavens, and come down; touch the mountains, that they smoke;

entries.title: Psalms 144:6
segments: Cast forth lightnings, and scatter them; send forth thine arrows, and discomfit them:

entries.title: Psalms 144:7
segments: Stretch out thy hands from above; rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of aliens,

entries.title: Psalms 144:8
segments: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 144:9
segments: ¶O God, I will sing a new song unto thee; with the ten-stringed lute will I sing psalms unto thee:

entries.title: Psalms 144:10
segments: Who givest salvation unto kings; who rescuest David thy servant from the hurtful sword.

entries.title: Psalms 144:11
segments: Rescue me, and deliver me from the hand of aliens, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 144:12
segments: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; our daughters as corner-columns, sculptured after the fashion of a palace:

entries.title: Psalms 144:13
segments: Our granaries full, affording all manner of store; our sheep bringing forth thousands, ten thousands in our pastures;

entries.title: Psalms 144:14
segments: Our kine laden [with young]; no breaking in and no going forth, and no outcry in our streets.

entries.title: Psalms 144:15
segments: Blessed the people that is in such a case! Blessed the people whose God is Jehovah!
